title: pH-responsive doxorubicin-loaded Artemisia argyi carbon dots: enhanced targeted therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37645-37659
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05688H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ruilong Jia, Ping Liu, Yanli Gong, Yuting Gao, Yajun Xiong, Xiaoyong Song, Jinglin Peng, Meiqi Lan, Xinli Shi
To resolve the poor targeting and severe side effects of DOX in HCC treatment, we synthesized CDs and loaded DOX to form CDs–DOX. It shows anti-HCC effects, reshapes intestinal flora, enhances intestinal barrier function, reduces DOX toxicity.
